## Why

In ork's run, orchestrator preflight found real spec gaps (S32, S97, S07, S33, S35, S45, S65), but each design question stopped a running relay: S07 took about 18 h and S27 about 19 h, against a median run of about 20 min. ork decided adj 164 (`roles.spec-check`) and built S116: a read-only spec-check role reads the next slices of a wave and returns, per slice, ready or structured questions, and the owner answers them in one sitting before any worktree exists. Line anchors are re-anchored late, by the implementer (ork S115).

The answers must reach the run. ork found (S116 review, 2026-10-26) that answers appended to the slice in the main checkout never reach a worktree cut from HEAD. The owner chose to carry the owner-decisions paragraph into the run's brief. A hand-run relay hit the same gap and recorded answers as a slicer note in the worktree. v8 says only "resume the orchestrator"; it names no record. ork's adj 170 (`process.owner-answers`) also lets the outer session record an option the owner explicitly picked as an adj decision.
